verdict.rationale: The SOS documents a print-and-mail path for annual reports through the Annual Report Wizard. It also runs a Forms page with paper forms such as the Appointment of New Registered Agent and Office and CRA registration/cancellation, so an offline rail for some tasks is evidenced. However, the pack never shows the actual mailing address, fax number, or a complete set of paper forms covering formation and other filings. Missing for 10: published exact mailing address, fax number or in-person submission details, paper forms for entity formation and amendments, and independent confirmation that mail filings are accepted and processed.
